newsitem.title: USA: Honeywell CFO backs $3.63 '97 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: Honeywell CFO backs $3.63 '97 EPS view.

text.p: Honeywell Inc, which reported double-digit 1996 earnings growth Thursday, backs the Wall Street consensus that it will earn $3.63 a share in 1997, chief financial officer William Hjerpe told Reuters.
"We're comfortable with the current consensus estimate of $3.63 and the range of $3.60 to $3.70 for 1997," Hjerpe said in a telephone interview.
He also said the company expects "five to 10 percent sales growth" in 1997.
Earlier, Minneapolis-based Honeywell reported 1996 earnings of $402.7 million or $3.18 a share, up from $333.6 million or $2.62 a share. Revenues advanced to $7.31 billion from $6.73 billion.
The company manufactures and sells controls for customers worldwide in homes and buildings, industrial and aviation and space markets.
